summary: Request: publish compatibility matrix for Quantization Profile Library (models x GPU SKUs x profile types)
description:
Issue summary:
Northstar Search asked for a "compatibility matrix" that clearly states which Quantization Profile types are supported per model and per GPU SKU, including any max context/sequence-length constraints and whether support differs across Hosted vs Dedicated.

Customer request:
- Provide a public-facing table (or equivalent docs page) for: Model variant → supported quantization profiles → supported hardware (H100/A100/L40S/A10) → constraints (max context, batch size caveats).
- Clarify behavior when a profile is enabled but incompatible (will it hard fail vs silently fallback?).
- They want something they can hand to their platform team before enabling profiles on production routes.

Impact:
- No outage; blockers for rollout planning and internal approvals.
- Customer is evaluating beta enablement on a Dedicated cluster and wants predictable behavior + documentation.

Notes from intake call/email:
- They saw the Console toggle but could not find a definitive reference that lists what is supported. They specifically asked about INT8 (W8A8) vs FP8 mix paths and whether A10 is supported.

What we know today (internal):
- Compatibility is enforced via policy evaluation + runtime guardrails. If incompatible, the request should safely fall back to baseline precision (and emit fallback metrics + log annotations). Console/API surfaces warnings/errors depending on the operation (enablement validation vs runtime resolution).
- We have an internal serving standard page (Confluence) but customer wants a public doc artifact.

Requested outcome:
- Public docs update that includes (a) how to check compatibility for a given model/profile/hardware, (b) current supported GPU classes at GA/beta, and (c) explicit fallback behavior and how to detect it.

Workaround requested:
- Provide a short-term, shareable list for the specific models they care about + guidance on verifying applied vs fallback using logs/metrics.
comments: 2025-03-14 09:22 (Dev Patel, Support): Opened on behalf of Northstar Search (Dedicated). They’re blocked on internal review until we can provide a compatibility matrix for quant profiles. Looping in Docs (Elliot) + Platform (Ethan) for authoritative wording and what we can safely publish externally.

2025-03-14 11:05 (Ethan Park, Control plane): Current behavior: enablement validation checks the selected route’s resolved model variant + deployment tier + region GPU class. If mismatch, API returns a compatibility error during config write. At runtime, if a route has a profile ref but the resolved execution environment is incompatible (rare, e.g., failover), runtime falls back to baseline and emits quant_profile_resolution_outcome=fallback. Please avoid language implying we support every GPU; support depends on published profile constraints.

2025-03-14 13:40 (Noah Patel, Runtime): Confirmed: we can publish a "GPU class" mapping (e.g., H100/H200 class, A100 class, L40S class) rather than every exact SKU string. Also note context-length caps on some mixed FP8/INT8 paths; we should document that profile metadata includes max_context_tokens and hardware_constraints; determinism is guaranteed by resolved profile_id + version.

2025-03-15 10:18 (Elliot Price, Docs): We can add a public section: "Compatibility & constraints" with (1) where to see supported profiles per model (Console dropdown), (2) what compatibility checks are performed, (3) what happens if incompatible (error at enable time; fallback at runtime under failover), and (4) a starter matrix for the most common models/GPU classes. Need sign-off from Applied ML on which model/profile combos are OK to list publicly.

2025-03-15 15:02 (Arjun Desai, Applied ML): OK to publish a limited matrix for the beta set only (Llama-3-70B, Mixtral-8x7B, and our top embedding model), and mark it "Beta coverage; expands weekly". Please do NOT generalize profile types across all models; each model has its own published profile artifacts and constraints.

2025-03-17 09:10 (Dev Patel, Support): Sent customer interim guidance:
- For a given route/model, use Console → Route → Quantization → "Select profile" to see only compatible, published profiles.
- If they want a hard artifact, we can share a beta-only table for the two requested models and GPU classes used in their Dedicated cluster.
- Incompatibility during enablement returns an error (won’t save config). In rare cases of runtime failover/incompatible execution, the system falls back to baseline and you can detect it via logs/metrics (quant_profile_id present + resolution outcome).
Customer confirmed this unblocks internal discussion while we wait for public docs.

2025-03-18 14:26 (Elliot Price, Docs): Public docs PR updated with a new section "Compatibility & constraints" and a beta coverage matrix + explicit note that support is defined by published profiles for that model. Also referenced how to detect fallback using request logs/traces. Linking PR in related PRs.
resolution:
Provided interim compatibility guidance to Northstar Search and coordinated a docs update to publish a beta-scoped compatibility matrix + clear explanation of compatibility checks and fallback behavior.

Customer-facing outcome:
- Short-term: shared beta-only compatibility table for the requested models/GPU classes and instructions to validate compatibility via Console.
- Long-term: public docs updated (via docs PR) with a "Compatibility & constraints" section, describing how compatibility is determined (published profile constraints), what happens on incompatibility (enable-time error; runtime fallback under failover), and how to verify applied vs fallback using logs/metrics.

Next steps (non-blocking):
- Expand the published matrix as additional model profiles are added to the library; keep matrix explicitly scoped to published profiles and avoid generic promises per quant method.
